title: Fold the Claude CLI under TextProvider: the default engine runs the shared layer
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: a CLI timeout raises LLMError(subtype='deadline_exceeded') directly, permanent, exactly 1 spawn (acceptance 3 pins spawn count 1). test_llm_registry.py retargeted (8 isinstance pins now ClaudeCliAdapter; the no-config case also asserts TextProvider and NOT a ClaudeCliProvider). test_claude_cli_terms.py needed NO change - the adapter's delegated strip_api_key/billing_lane/availability keep it green - so the write set shrank by that file. llm_judge.py / eval/judging.py skip `isinstance(res, Exception)` rather than importing LLMError, because llm_judge documents that it must stay importable without the ..llm chain (covers ClaudeCliError and LLMError both). The claude-cli-default ledger label lives in monitor._ledger_model (applies to emit_result and emit_error) because base.complete emits failures with self.model (None on a default install) and base.py is outside the write set; adapter.model stays None so provider_identity ('claude_cli/default') is unchanged. MonitoredClaudeCli is a PEP 562 lazy module attribute aliasing ClaudeCliAdapter (an eager import would cycle base->monitor->adapter->base). Adapter NOT added to adapters.ADAPTERS (would change capability/lockstep iteration). Adapter stamps finish_reason from the envelope's stop_reason when present. Test file uses a stubbed subprocess.run (counts real spawns) rather than patching ClaudeCliProvider.complete.
notes: Python gate: 2996 tests OK, skipped=4 (baseline 2986, skipped=4; KP_SKIP_BASELINE untouched). test:eval:ci exit 0 - none of matching/automation(--no-llm)/fault/intake(--no-llm) construct a CLI provider (grep), so keyless behaviour is unchanged. ruff on touched files clean; ruff-ratchet 0. tsc/typecheck exit 2 ONLY on 80 errors under untracked kpi-sim/runs/** (foreign, not tracked, pre-existing); schemas:gen ran clean and rewrote contract-constants.generated.ts with CRLF only - restored. test:perf red on TS import-graph ceilings (app/page.tsx, app/api/**/route.ts) - this card touches no TS, so every overage is a sibling's uncommitted TS work. Full test:unit 10530/10530 green. Behaviour changes to flag for integration: (1) the default engine now retries overloaded/5xx envelopes (up to 3 spawns inside the caller's deadline) and makes one repair re-prompt on unparseable JSON (a second spawn) - bench record_calls will count that second call; (2) under KP_OFFLINE a direct complete() on the CLI adapter now raises offline_egress_blocked before spawning (previously only availability() refused); (3) the adapter returns LLMResult, whose cost_usd is None when the envelope had no cost (was 0.0 on ClaudeResult) - no production caller reads it arithmetically (grep); (4) map() failures are LLMError, not ClaudeCliError - the only two isinstance(ClaudeCliError) consumers of registry providers were fixed; interview_eval/interview_optimize/seed_* catch ClaudeCliError but construct bare ClaudeCliProvider, unaffected. Doc committed alone under the lock (taken and released by this builder).
